title: S3 → Glue → Athena
description: A serverless, query-in-place pattern: land Parquet in S3, catalogue it with Glue, and query with Athena while keeping scanned bytes (and cost) low.
implementation: Write Parquet compressed, target 128 MB files.
Define the table with projection on dt (no MSCK REPAIR).
Query only the needed columns; compare scanned bytes before/after.
repo_structure:
s3-glue-athena/
  terraform/            # s3, glue catalog, athena workgroup
  ddl/table.sql         # partition projection DDL
  queries/*.sql
  data/dt=2026-09-01/*.parquet
architecture:
Parquet in S3 (Hive layout: dt=..) ─▶ Glue Data Catalog ─▶ Athena (serverless SQL)
          ▲                                                     │
    [Terraform: buckets, catalog, workgroup with bytes limit]    └─▶ BI / notebooks
